_comment: Shared AEAD known-answer test vectors for cross-implementation consistency. All three SPsec implementations (this repo's C participant, the sibling canopens_configurator_linux C configurator, and the canopens_configurator_python submodule) must produce byte-identical ciphertext+tag for these fixed inputs, since AES-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 are standardized primitives with no implementation-defined behavior. A mismatch here means one implementation has a real bug (wrong key/nonce/AAD handling, wrong backend wiring, etc), not a legitimate divergence. Loaded directly by canopens_configurator_python/tests/test_kat_vectors.py; the two C repos' tests/test_nonce.c files hardcode a copy of these same values (see the comment there) rather than adding a JSON parser dependency to a plain-C test harness - if you change a vector here, update both C copies too.

vectors._note: wolfSSL backend only - not comparable against mbedTLS (no ASCON support) or Python's mbedtls-only path if it lacks the wolfssl-py ASCON binding.
